thread:
jordan: DeployBot alerted high tail-timeouts on text-gen-eu -> observed 504s as clients hit 10s timeout. Proposing emergency pin to runtime v4.1.1-quantfix + partial ramp. Need 2 fast approvals to use expedited rollback window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Incident #4799 - Elevated 504 on /v1/generate (eu). 504 rate: 2.7% over 5m. Suggested action: pin runtime v4.1.1-quantfix, canary 15% for 3m then ramp.

lee: what's the difference in that runtime? will quant change affect accuracy?

jordan: small quant kernel fix that avoids a rare slow path for short responses. Accuracy delta <0.1% in perf tests. main risk is slower KV warming.

mina: ops note: if we pin we should pre-warm KV on new hosts. ops will start warmup job once pin goes live.

henry: billing note: using burst nodes for warmup may incur spot charges. ok to proceed. :ok_hand:

jordan: asking for approvals. @lee @mina please react.

lee: approving — go ahead. :rocket:

mina: approving, ops ready. :white_check_mark:

jordan: issuing pin now: ```
deployctl pin --svc text-gen-eu --ver v4.1.1-quantfix --reason "504 tail timeouts" --window 20m
```

deploy-bot: Command accepted. Starting canary: 15% traffic to pinned set. Warmup job queued.

ops-bot: Warmup job started on 6 nodes; estimated ready in ~90s.

jordan: monitoring windows: canary check at +2m and +5m. rollback thresholds: 504s > 1.5% or p99 latency +200ms -> immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +2m: 504 rate 0.3% (down from 2.7%), p99 -10ms. KV warmup progress: 40% hosts warmed.

lee: nice. any customer-facing impact? should we trigger status page?

mina: not yet, improvement detected. hold off on status update for now.

henry: drafting release blurb: "v4.1.1-quantfix 1 Apr - emergency tail latency fix for EU text-gen; rolled via expedite window." will push to changelog.

jordan: set expedited flag to true for 20m window. notify support for potential follow-ups.

deploy-bot: Expedited window active. Final metrics will post at window end.

lee: small ask: add a short postmortem when this is closed w/ root cause + monitoring rule to catch it earlier.

jordan: yes - will put a template in thread when stable. thanks all. :pray:

deploy-bot: Pin completed. Canary successful. Expedited window ends in 18m.
